summary.intent: Execute Phase 24 (Bug Fixes & Test Infrastructure) for cipher-box, then review and clean up the code, create a PR, and resolve all CI failures and review comments.
summary.outcome: All 3 plans executed successfully in parallel, PR #361 created, CI build fixed, CodeRabbit review comments resolved, and an E2E test assertion updated to match new auto-repair behavior.

repo: Device registry has a v1/v2 schema migration path — new registries created as v2, old v1 registries read leniently via migration in schema.ts
resolveIpnsRecord throws on transient HTTP errors (5xx, network) but returns null on explicit 404 or !response.success — auto-repair in loadBin only triggers on true 'not found' responses
computeIpHash() exists in apps/web/src/lib/device/info.ts and should be used instead of inline SHA-256 computation
Stale package builds (.d.ts files) can cause spurious TypeScript errors in dependent packages — crypto and api-client packages need rebuilding after changes
The load test client pool uses a 401 interceptor with token refresh coalescing via createSdkContext()
recovery.html previously had a dead export-file recovery mode for v1 vaults; all vaults are now v2 so it was safely removed (322 lines)

code.finding: publishWithVerify should publish once then retry only the verification step — not re-publish on every retry attempt

validateRegistryShape() narrows obj.devices inside its own scope but TypeScript doesn't propagate that narrowing to callers — requires 'as unknown[]' cast after the call; also ipHash auto-heal should only apply to empty string, not other malformed values
Variables declared with let inside a try block are out of scope in the finally block — must hoist declarations above the try
After auto-repair change, a fresh bin load returns sequenceNumber: 1 (published once during repair) not 0 — E2E assertion must match new behavior

workflow: TypeScript narrowing from helper validation functions does not propagate to callers — use type assertions or assertion function signatures when the caller needs the narrowed type
GSD wave execution: all 3 parallel agents completed independently with minor auto-fixes for type signature mismatches; spot-checks (SUMMARY.md + git log grep) confirm correctness
CI failures caught a TS18046 error ('unknown' type) that local builds missed — pnpm build for individual packages generates DTS, catching cross-package type errors before push
CodeRabbit review threads can be replied to via REST (in_reply_to comment ID) and resolved via GraphQL resolveReviewThread mutation

friction: CI caught a TypeScript error (TS18046 on schema.ts:96) that local builds didn't surface — required an extra commit/push cycle
sdk-core-workload.ts try/catch/finally structure was broken during initial simplification fix, requiring a second read-and-fix pass
The auto-repair change to loadBin broke an E2E test assertion (sequenceNumber 0→1) that wasn't caught until CI ran the sdk-e2e suite
Web app had 6 pre-existing type errors caused by stale package builds, not actual code issues — required rebuilding crypto and api-client packages to resolve
open_items: 2 SDK integration tests are skipped because the API is not running locally — these are never validated in the local dev loop
byo-file-workload.ts had pre-existing type errors beyond the cid/pinSize fix — only the out-of-scope variable errors were addressed
The resolveIpnsRecord !response.success path (API says not found but DB cache may exist) could trigger auto-repair incorrectly in some edge cases — not investigated
